mechanism: Both drugs can cause QT prolongation and electrolyte disturbances (hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) that increase arrhythmia risk, particularly in patients with renal impairment or concurrent cardiotoxic agents.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes (magnesium, potassium, calcium) before and during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration with zoledronic acid infusion and consider alternative antiemetics if QT prolongation is present.
